item.title: Kusatsu International Ski Resort: Powder Snow Meets Hot Spring — Guide
item.description: Kusatsu International Ski Resort combines reliable, high-quality powder snow with the rare advantage of Japan’s top-ranked hot spring town at its base, letting skiers and snowboarders soak away the day’s exertion in Kusatsu’s mineral-rich waters. The resort offers slopes suited to a range of skill levels, from gentle beginner runs to more challenging terrain, with panoramic views over the surrounding mountains from the higher lift stations on clear winter days.
